goal: Rust-own the public Q8_0 matmul ABI through current-C-compatible expanded BLAS and native prequantized dispatch without claiming specialized Q8 consumers or route promotion.

semantics: current C resolves a packed Q8 model range, uses expanded F32 then F16 BLAS for eligible multi-token work, and otherwise quantizes F32 activations into native Q8 kernels
current C selects one-token warp8, eligible batched warp8, or generic native dispatch and enables DP4A unless DS4_CUDA_NO_Q8_DP4A is present
current C falls back to native Q8 after a failed expanded F16 BLAS attempt

implementation.dp4a_path: embedded Q8 kernels select cuda_device integer::dp4a_i8 for full blocks unless DS4_CUDA_NO_Q8_DP4A is set

implementation.linkage_requirement: the C-linked proof currently retains Rust exports and embedded kernels with --whole-archive
